intro: {{nameA}} and {{nameB}} both offer {{course}} programmes in {{cityA}}. This page compares recorded year fees, 2023 placements and India Today ranks from our table, with official sites opened in {{year}}.
IPS Academy vs Prestige Institute of Management and Research is an Indore BBA comparison. Both are private colleges, and the 2023 placement rows sit close together.

sections.heading: IPS Academy vs Prestige Institute (PIMR) Indore for BBA: which is better in 2026
paragraphs: Choose Prestige Institute if you want recorded year Total Fees of ₹55,000 on several BBA streams, a 2023 banking and finance row of ₹4 lakh average and ₹9 lakh highest, and an India Today rank of 27 in 2024 and 2023.
Choose IPS Academy if that campus fits you, with a recorded Total Fees year figure of ₹91,000 for BBA, a 2023 row of ₹4 lakh average and ₹8 lakh highest, and an India Today rank of 52 in 2024.

sections.heading: Fees: what our records show, and what to watch
paragraphs: For IPS Academy we hold ₹91,000 as a Total Fees year figure for BBA. That is a year figure, not a confirmed official three-year total, and we have not multiplied it.
For Prestige Institute we hold ₹55,000 as a Total Fees year figure for BBA Banking & Finance, Business Analytics, Logistics & Supply Chain Management and BBA General.
Confirm the current notices on ipsacademy.org and pimrindore.ac.in before you budget, including any specialisation charges.

sections.heading: Placements compared
paragraphs: IPS Academy has a 2023 BBA row of ₹4 lakh average and ₹8 lakh highest. Prestige Institute has a 2023 BBA Banking & Finance row of ₹4 lakh average and ₹9 lakh highest.
These are historical records for those programmes, not a promise for every BBA stream. Ask both campuses for a later official undergraduate report.

sections.heading: Admission, ranks and eligibility
paragraphs: No entrance exam is mapped on this page. Follow each college's official undergraduate admissions process.

On our records, Prestige Institute has India Today BBA ranks of 27 in 2024 and 2023, and 24 in 2021. IPS Academy has India Today ranks of 52 in 2024, 56 in 2023 and 55 in 2021. These are not NIRF ranks.

sections.heading: Location and campus
paragraphs: Both are private colleges recorded in Indore, Madhya Pradesh, so a local student can visit them on the same day.
Prestige Institute lists several BBA specialisations, including foreign trade in the programme list. IPS Academy is listed here with a general BBA row. Match the exact stream.

sections.heading: Verdict: who should pick which college
paragraphs: Pick Prestige Institute if the lower recorded year fee, the 2023 highest of ₹9 lakh and the India Today rank of 27 fit you, after official confirmation.
Pick IPS Academy if that campus is the offer you have, after you confirm the official ₹91,000-scale year fee.
The 2023 averages on this page are the same at ₹4 lakh. Let the specialisation, campus visit and official fee notice decide.
